message_text: Priya, thanks for fixing the note yesterday. Can you confirm it says 65 is the planning date?
Confirmed. Formal planning date is 65; 60 is recorded as something you're exploring. The clarification is dated Mar 4 and the earlier note stays in the history.
Good. And Hannah, she said April, right?
Yes, you told me she'd come back in April. I'll chase you, not her.
yo any news on the tender comparison? deadline's coming up
Not done yet. I owe it to you. Target is early next week. I'll message when it's ready.
ok. the maybes are still maybes btw
Understood. Nothing is decided.
Elena sorry for the late msg. Feeding at 3am makes me think about the house thing.
Not asking you to do anything
No apology needed! I hope you're getting some sleep. We can talk about house timing whenever you're ready. Nothing is due.
Ok. Maybe after my leave settles? Idk
That's perfectly fine. I'll bring it up next call only if you want me to.
Priya I cannot stop thinking about the annuity man. He phoned again.
You don't have to speak to him. Would you like me to handle it?
No no. I will tell him I am thinking.
That's fine. We talk tomorrow at 9:15. Nothing to sign before then.
Elena dear it is Peg. Colleen showed me how to do this on the phone
Colleen says Maplewood wants a deposit soon. Do I have to
Lovely to hear from you, Peg. No, nothing is due. You told me you are only looking.
Yes only looking. Thank you dear
signed the tender paperwork and sent it to the company. half, 75k like we said
Got it. Please forward the company's receipt for the file.
will do. maybe tmrw
Daniel. I keep going back and forth. Is it crazy to wait two years?
Not crazy. It's a legitimate option and I'd rather you choose it than drift into it. What changed since this morning?
Nothing. Just twenty-two years of me.
Understood. Let's use our Wednesday 11:15 slot to go through it properly.
Okay. I'm not deciding by text.
Mateo has a recruiter call tomorrow. Could be nothing
Thanks for telling me. I don't need numbers until there is an actual offer.
Right. I'll keep you posted
Not asking my manager about four days yet. Please don't put it down as a plan
Recorded as something he hinted at, not something you've requested.
Thank you. Fridays with Lucia are tempting though
Elena thank you for this morning. The garden was lovely but I felt rushed by the lady. Frank was tired afterwards
Thank you for telling me, Peg. There is nothing to decide. Send the contract when you can.
Colleen will help me with it
re lisbon, i told camille what you said. her employer might allow remote, she's asking
Fine. It's still a possibility and it's not in your numbers.
I looked at 529s and there are SO many options. Can you just tell me which one?
My suggestion, not a decision: a low-fee plan from your own state. I can send two options to compare. You decide.
Let's hold off until the autumn. I'm drowning right now
Understood. Deferred until the autumn. I'll note it as open.
camille's employer said no remote for now. lisbon is off the table for the moment
Understood. I'll record it as off for now; it can come back. No budget changes.
yeah. the puppy is expensive enough lol
Priya, did the Seoul note get fixed? It's program fee, flights and housing. Not extra tuition.
Corrected on May 29, and I emailed the correction the same day.
Great. The program office says acceptance letters go out in late June.
Okay. The earmark stays. We'll look at it again at the half-year review.
Priya did it happen today? the first step
Yes. About $24,000 went into the global equity fund this morning. It is the first of six steps.
Thank you. I feel sick and excited at the same time
That is a normal mix. We'll read the statement together on Friday.
Did I say the aide comes five days now since Frank fell
You did, yesterday. I've corrected my model from four days to five. The May invoice was about $6,400.
Yes that is right
Reminder: policy summaries for the broker. He needs them for the disability quotes.
ugh yes. this week
Quick one. My lawyer thinks the retention pool is worth raising with Lakeshore. Should I?
My view is that it's worth raising as a request, ideally with Lakeshore co-funding. It's still your call. Your after-tax cost is the number to keep in mind.
I haven't decided how much.
Then don't put a number in writing yet.
Fine. Holding it.
Priya I looked again. It is down more. Should I stop the plan

We talked about exactly this this morning. You don't need to decide anything tonight. The next step is July 1, and I'll call you first if the holding is down more than ten percent from the first purchase.
Thank you. I will try not to look
Good. Message me if you want to talk before then.
Paid both this morning from the cash account. The lawyer's forty thousand retainer and Mei Lin's fifteen thousand advance.
Thanks. So the fifty-five thousand has now left your cash, as we agreed on Monday. I'll update my records.
Fine. No surprises, I hope.
Hannah confirmed in writing that her estimate assumed the first January after my 63rd birthday. I'll forward it.
Good, thank you. That matches the plan's definition.
I'll submit the form on Monday. Mariko as primary beneficiary. Contingent names later.
Fine. Please send me the signed copy once it's in.
Will do.
Colleen found Frank's pension papers. Do I send them to you
Please use the secure portal, Peg, not a photo by text or email. Colleen can upload it.
She will do it Sunday
Daniel, are you free for a quick question later today?
Yes, after two o'clock.
Great, I'll message then.
Priya, the portal wouldn't let me log in this morning.
Please use the password reset link on the login page and tell me if it still fails.
It worked. Thanks.
Elena dear did my last message arrive
Yes it did, Peg. Thank you.
Thank you for this morning, Priya. It helped to go through it slowly.
I am glad, Grace. Message me whenever you like.
Thanks Daniel, that was clear.
Glad it was useful, Lucas. Speak soon.
Hi Elena, the document is in the portal now.
Received, thank you Sofia.
